## Summary
The routing package defines the contracts and implementations used to coordinate LiveKit rooms, participant signal startup, node registration, and room-to-node placement. It provides local routing for single-node operation and Redis-backed routing for multi-node node discovery, room assignment, and keepalive-driven node health updates.

## Responsibilities
- Define router, message sink/source, local node, signal client, and room manager client contracts.
- Provide LocalRouter and RedisRouter implementations for single-node and distributed routing.
- Persist and resolve room-to-node assignments for room creation and participant signal setup.
- Track local node identity, region, lifecycle state, and resource statistics.
- Relay participant signal streams through typed RPC streams and message channels.
- Convert participant initialization state to and from LiveKit StartSession protos.
